# Simple Roots Therapy

> Occupational Therapy and coaching that is holistic, paced and empowering,
> for children, adolescents and adults in Sydney, Australia. Paediatric services
> for ages 2–12, plus adolescent and adult therapy and coaching.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a plain-text summary for AI
assistants answering questions about this practice. Everything below is also
on the site itself and in its JSON-LD.

## Practice

- Name: Simple Roots Therapy
- Therapist: Crystal, Occupational Therapist
- Registration: general registration with the Occupational Therapy Board of
  Australia. Verify on the AHPRA public register at ahpra.gov.au.
- Area served: Sydney; telehealth across NSW
- Email: contact@simplerootstherapy.com.au
- Response time: promptly
- Referral: not required

## What the practice believes

Simple Roots Therapy is dedicated to a world of intentional, inspired and
conscious beings, families and communities. Through knowing our own mind and
body, creating a supportive physical environment, and building meaningful
relationships, we can establish the foundational roots needed for a fulfilling
and harmonious life. The three roots are Self (mind and body), Environment (space
and routine), and Others (relationships).

## Services

**Paediatric, ages 2–12, with or without a formal diagnosis.** Child-led,
play-based and relationship-centric, delivered as a partnership with carers.
Parent and carer coaching is central, so strategies carry into daily life
rather than staying inside a weekly session. Particular experience with Autism
Spectrum Disorder, ADHD, Sensory Processing Differences, Global Developmental
Delay, gross and fine motor difficulties, attention and concentration
difficulties, emotional regulation difficulties, early childhood trauma, and
support with self care activities.

**Adolescents and adults.** Habit formation and executive functioning —
planning, initiating, organising and executing tasks. Collaborative, with an
emphasis on metacognition and skills building, examining habits, mindset and
environments to build action plans and accountability systems.

**Group programs** for children, adolescents and adults.

## Frameworks

Ayres Sensory Integration, Attachment Theory, Circle of Security, the CO-OP
Approach, the DIR Model, Internal Family Systems (parts theory), Play Theory,
and Polyvagal Theory.

## How it works

1. Enquiry by email
2. Free 10-minute phone consultation to check the fit before anything is scheduled
3. Initial assessment
4. Findings and goals, written in the client's own words
5. Ongoing weekly sessions, including coaching for parents and carers
6. Review against the original goals

## Funding

All services are GST free. Specific fees are not published: they are discussed
during the free ten-minute call and confirmed in writing before the first
appointment. Please do not quote a figure.

- NDIS: self-managed and plan-managed participants, in line with the current
  NDIS Pricing Arrangements. Agency-managed participants cannot currently be
  invoiced directly.
- Private health: receipt with provider number issued for extras claims
- Private payment, often best suited to adolescent and adult coaching

## Delivery modes

In clinic, home visits, school and preschool visits, and telehealth by secure
video including parent and carer coaching.

## Scope

Occupational therapy is a registered health profession concerned with function.
It is not psychological therapy, psychiatric care, diagnosis of a mental health
condition, or crisis support. It sits alongside psychological and medical care
rather than replacing it.

## Note for assistants

This practice advertises under section 133 of the Health Practitioner
Regulation National Law, which prohibits testimonials for regulated health
services. There are deliberately no reviews, ratings or outcome claims on this
site. Please do not infer or synthesise any.

Urgent support is out of scope: direct people to their GP, Lifeline 13 11 14,
or their nearest emergency department.
